title: Transcendence & Kick off
description: This is a project when you can play, chat, and connect with others while enjoying a great experience and building meaningful connections.

title: Rakayib - mobile marketplace
description: A mobile marketplace connecting buyers and sellers of horses and camels. Discover auctions, explore animal details, place bids, and follow every order through to delivery.

title: 13 BUS - Mobile Booking
description: 13 BUS is a mobile bus-booking concept designed to simplify everyday travel. Users can choose a pickup location, browse trips, check seat availability and departure times, and access a QR travel pass with their journey details—all within a clear, blue-toned interface.

title: Skills Center - Booking Platform
description: Skills Center is a web platform designed to simplify discovering and reserving sports facilities. Users can explore fields and courts for football, basketball, tennis, and volleyball, view facility details and opening hours, and book a space for their preferred date and time.
